question: Mrinalini Sarabhai is known for which of the following classical dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam and Kathakali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Mrinalini Vikram Sarabhai

 
 
• Indian classical dancer and choreographer Mrinalini Vikram Sarabhai were well-known worldwide.
 
• In the city of Ahmedabad, she was the founder and director of the Darpana Academy of Performing Arts, a school for teaching dance, theatre, music, and puppetry.
 
• She was honoured with numerous honours and citations for her contributions to Kathakali and Bharatnatyam.
